entities.summary: Bart Stevens is a Dutch tennis player who specializes in doubles. He reached his career-high Association of Tennis Professionals (ATP) doubles ranking of world No. 57 on 16 March 2026 and a career high singles ranking of No. 736 achieved on 14 October 2019. Stevens has won ten ITF-Futures, thirteen ATP Challenger Tour titles, has reached three ATP-250 finals (2025), one ATP-500 semifinal (2026) and a Wimbledon quarterfinal (2023). Bart Stevens was a athletes & competitors from Waalwijk (b. 1998-01-29, Waalwijk). Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
